subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: The system shall treat a feature draft as ready only when every Must requirement in its PRD carries a pass/fail fit criterion and a verification method.
rationale: Every must-have requirement has a pass/fail test (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-3)
fit_criterion: A draft with one Must requirement lacking a fit criterion, and one lacking a verification method, are each refused naming the requirement.
